```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library("naboer")
```

Keys identify series. `.by` limits dependence to independent domains. Explicitly
choose whether temporal windows span all series in a domain or stay inside each
series. Ordinary tibbles need explicit metadata; tsibbles supply it.

```{r}
x <- tibble::tibble(
  site = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 12),
  date = rep(as.Date("2024-01-01") + 0:11, 2)
)
f <- neighbourhoods(x,
  key = site, index = date, within = "key",
  temporal = temporal_window(time_span(2, "days"))
)
tibble::as_tibble(f, folds = 1:3)
```

Elapsed days are exactly 86,400 seconds. Calendar days follow local civil time
and can span 23 or 25 hours across daylight-saving changes. Calendar months/years
clamp invalid month-end dates. Ambiguous/nonexistent times error unless explicitly
resolved with `time_span()` arguments. Numeric indices are seconds. Tsibble
year-week/month/quarter indices use period-start dates for queries;
`fold_data()` preserves their original class.

Observation-count spans count actual rows and require `within = "key"`. They do
not infer missing observations. Resolve tied times within a counted series first.
Duration windows can include simultaneous observations.

```{r}
blocks <- temporal_folds(x, time_span(4, "days"),
  key = site, index = date,
  within = "domain", origin = as.Date("2024-01-01")
)
tibble::as_tibble(blocks)
```

Windows include both boundaries; adjacent blocks are half-open. Default block
origins are the earliest observation in each selected domain or series.

## Forecasting

An origin defines what was available for fitting. Exclude the gap, then score the
assessment horizon. All later observations remain omitted, including those beyond
the horizon. Origins span all participating series in a domain by default.

```{r}
forecast <- forecast_folds(x,
  initial = time_span(3, "days"),
  horizon = time_span(2, "days"), gap = time_span(1, "days"),
  key = site, index = date
)
tibble::as_tibble(forecast)
analysis_indices(forecast, 1)
assessment_indices(forecast, 1)
```

Use `window = "sliding"` with `lookback` for finite training history. Generated
origins require complete horizons; empty generated assessment windows are
skipped. Explicit `origins` require nonempty training and assessment in every
participating domain. Construct predictors and imputations using only information
available at each origin in explicit-refit workflows.

```{r tsibble, eval=requireNamespace("tsibble", quietly=TRUE)}
series <- tsibble::as_tsibble(x, key = site, index = date)
temporal_folds(series, time_span(4, "days"), within = "key")
```
